tools.name: search_series
tools.description: Find book series by name. Returns up to 5 matches, each linking to its reading-order page.

tools.name: search_authors
tools.description: Find authors by name. Returns up to 5 matches, each linking to the author page.

tools.name: get_reading_order
tools.description: Get the reading order of one book series, looked up by series name. Returns the best match only.

tools.name: get_author_series
tools.description: Given an author name, return the best-matching author and the titles of the book series they wrote (up to 25). Use get_reading_order with a title for its books.

tools.name: find_series_for_book
tools.description: Given a book's title and author, return the series it belongs to, its position, and the series order.
